main_text.head: IN VINDICIARVM
Partem posteriorem.
main_text.p: EXCVSSIMVS Argumenta externa à testimonijs petita, quæ ex tribus primis Centurijs pro suis Ignatianis adduxerat Vir doctus, fuséque demonstravimus valere adhuc Dallæi objectiones ; etsi eas refellere pro virili, sed frustrà conatus sit eruditus Pearsonius; testibus in contrarium à Dallæo allatis auctoritatem suam vindicavimus, & præterea duo negativa Dallæi Argumenta expendimus , & Viri docti hypothesi non parum nocere ostendimus, idem de cæteris facilimè ostensuri , nisi brevitati studeremus , & observationes scribere tantùm statuissemus. Iam ventilanda nobis sunt Argumenta interna ex Epistolis ipsis ducta, quamvis non tàm Argumenta proponat ipse Pearsonius, ut in fronte seu in titulo promittebat , quàm Dallæi objectiones confutare nitatur. Ut ut est præcipua exI.

page.notes: The large woodcut initial E is set in an ornamental frame and joined to "EXCVSSIMVS", which is printed in small capitals. The text breaks off mid-sentence at the foot of the page and continues on the next page. Long s is normalised to s; the printed spelling "oftendimus" and "oftensuri" is given as "ostendimus" and "ostensuri" by the u/v and s rules only where a letter is unclear.
